title: Explosive Mace
description: This mod adds a new enchantment to the mace known as 'Explosive'. Can you guess what it does?
body:
--------------------------
DESCRIPTION

--------------------------

A simple mod that adds an enchantment to the mace so that when you smash-attack a mob, it will explode with the force of 1 block of TNT. The enchantment is in enchantment tables, villager trades and loot tables wherever any other enchanted book can be found.

---------------------------
TRAILER

---------------------------

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/m-vf4_e9Ljg" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---------------------------
KNOWN ISSUES

---------------------------
- When the mace also has Wind Burst, the mace will do nothing and then, 1 second later, blasts you up, so using Wind Burst is not recommended.
